subject: CS470
filterSummary: Successfully selected 4 of 5 English videos and 2 of 5 Arabic videos. Coverage was strong for core topics like Triangulation, Semi-Structured Interviews, and Likert Scales. More niche topics like Ethnographic Observation and Interaction Logging had poor or no coverage in Arabic, and the English selection for Interaction Logging was also left empty due to a lack of videos focusing on data analysis over data capture.

coverage.note: Selected under the view count exception rule as no candidate reached 3000 views.
No candidates specifically teach designing semi-structured interviews; shortlisted videos were on broader topics or post-interview analysis, failing the relevance gate.
No videos specifically on ethnographic observation were found in Arabic; shortlisted videos on general observation were not relevant enough.
No videos specifically covered the analysis of interaction logs for HCI insights. The only borderline candidate focused on data capture, not analysis, failing the relevance gate.
No candidates on indirect observation via interaction logging were found in Arabic. All shortlisted videos were irrelevant.
